Custom bar accessories: select by function and material

Build a shortlist of custom coasters, bottle openers, wine stoppers, silicone straws, can coolers and bar tools. Match the material and function to each reference rather than treating all accessories as the same product.

Custom coasters with logo ↗Custom bottle & wine openers ↗Custom bar accessories · can coolers ↗Custom bar accessories · silicone straws ↗
Are silicone sleeves, neoprene sleeves and foam can coolers interchangeable?

No. They are different material or construction references. Match the intended can, bottle or glass, then confirm the material and decoration for the specific model.

BROWSE BY CATEGORY

Custom Bar Mats ↗Custom Reusable Straws ↗

Bar mats, can coolers, straws and tools

Bar accessories cover mats, sleeves, straws and serving tools. Sizes, materials and logo methods are made to your specification rather than pulled from a fixed list.

Do you make can coolers and bottle sleeves?

Silicone sleeves and cooler styles are available; fit must be checked against your container, so send the dimensions or a physical reference.

Can bar mats be made to size?

Bar and rail mats are produced to your required size and material. Send the dimensions and quantity.

Which logo method suits bar accessories?

It depends on the material: printing for plastic and silicone, laser marking for metal components.

Can coolers, koozies and bottle sleeves

Can coolers and koozies are made in silicone and neoprene styles, including slim can sizes, zip-up bottle sleeves and personalised runs for weddings, breweries and promotions. Fit is the deciding factor: send the can or bottle dimensions, or a physical sample, and we match the sleeve to it. Logos are applied by printing for silicone and neoprene; bulk and personalised orders run on the same line.

Coasters, trays, ice buckets and serving tools

Bar accessories extend to coasters, serving trays, ice buckets, stir sticks and straws in plastic and silicone. Sizes are produced to your specification rather than taken from a fixed list, and the logo method follows the material — printing for plastic and silicone, laser marking for metal components.

Do you make slim can koozies?

Slim can sizes are produced alongside standard can coolers. Send the can dimensions or a physical sample so the sleeve is matched to the actual container.

Can I order personalised koozies in bulk?

Personalised and bulk koozie orders run on the same line in silicone and neoprene. Send the quantity, artwork and container dimensions.

Are neoprene and zip-up bottle koozies available?

Neoprene styles and zip-up bottle sleeves are available. Construction and closure are confirmed against your bottle before production.

定制酒具配件：按功能与材料选款

杯垫、开瓶器、酒塞、硅胶吸管、罐套与酒吧工具应分别选款，逐个核对材料和功能，避免把不同配件当成同一种产品。

定制 Logo 杯垫 ↗定制瓶盖与红酒开瓶器 ↗定制酒具配件 · can coolers ↗定制酒具配件 · silicone straws ↗
硅胶套、氯丁橡胶套和泡沫罐套可以混为一类吗？

不可以，它们对应不同材料或结构参考。应先核对罐、瓶或杯的适配，再确认具体型号的材料与装饰。

按品类浏览

定制吧台垫 ↗定制吸管 ↗

吧台垫、罐套、吸管与工具

酒具配件包含吧台垫、套筒、吸管与服务工具。尺寸、材料和 Logo 工艺按您的要求定制，不是固定清单。

是否做罐套和瓶套？

硅胶套筒与罐套款式可做；适配性需按容器确认，请提供尺寸或实物参考。

吧台垫可以按要求尺寸做吗？

吧台垫与导轨垫按所需尺寸和材料生产，请提供尺寸与数量。

酒具配件适合哪种 Logo 工艺？

按材料决定：塑料与硅胶用印刷，金属件用激光打标。

罐套、瓶套与杯套

罐套与瓶套提供硅胶和潜水料款式，含细罐（slim can）尺寸、拉链瓶套，以及婚礼、酒馆和促销用的个性化订单。适配是关键：请提供罐/瓶尺寸或实物，我们按实物配套筒。硅胶与潜水料用印刷做 Logo，批量与个性化订单同线生产。

杯垫、托盘、冰桶与服务工具

酒具配件还包括杯垫、托盘、冰桶、搅拌棒和吸管，材质为塑料与硅胶。尺寸按您的要求生产，不是固定清单；Logo 工艺按材料决定——塑料与硅胶用印刷，金属件用激光打标。

是否做细罐（slim can）罐套？

细罐尺寸与标准罐套同样生产。请提供罐体尺寸或实物，以便按实物配套筒。

个性化罐套可以批量下单吗？

个性化与批量罐套订单在硅胶和潜水料产线同线生产。请提供数量、图稿和容器尺寸。

有潜水料和拉链款瓶套吗？

潜水料款式和拉链瓶套都可做。结构与封口按您的瓶型在生产前确认。
